Frequently Asked Questions
Check out the most common questions about affiliate management and Rewardful's hands-off solution.
How Quickly Can I Get Started With Rewardful?
Launching an affiliate program with Rewardful typically only takes less than 15 minutes. Our seamless Stripe integration makes it easy for anyone to get started.
Can I Set Recurring and One-Time Affiliate Commissions on Rewardful?
Yes, Rewardful offers flexible affiliate payment structures. You can choose between recurring or one-time commissions, as well as percentage or fixed amounts. Additionally, you can set minimum payout thresholds for your affiliates.
How Does Rewardful Handle Affiliate Commissions for Upgrades, Downgrades, and Cancellations?
Rewardful automatically tracks and calculates every sales activity, including changes, ensuring accurate commission payouts . Once you set your commission rules, we handle recurring commissions, upgrades, downgrades, cancellations, refunds, and more.
How Can Rewardful Help Me Gain Insights Into My Affiliate Program’s Performance?
With Rewardful's accurate affiliate tracking , you can monitor your affiliates' performance in real time. Identify your top affiliates, pinpoint those who need support, and detect those violating affiliate agreements, such as self-referrals.
What is the Affiliate Finder?
Rewardful has a built-in Affiliate Finder search engine that tries to surface proven affiliates around the web based on queries you run.
To our knowledge, nothing else exists on the market like this.
What is an Affiliate Finder credit?
Rewardful has a built-in Affiliate Finder search engine that tries to surface proven affiliates around the web based on queries you run. A 'credit' is used when you reveal the details for a specific search result. Performing a search doesn't use a credit.
Credits reset to zero every billing cycle and unused credits do not rollover to the next month.
Is the Affiliate Finder similar to an affiliate marketplace? Are you pulling the results from your affiliate database?
No, the Affiliate Finder is very unique in that it crawls the web to find relevant affiliates based on your query. Marketplaces are a passive approach to recruiting affiliates and are often filled with low quality, poorly vetted affiliates that aren't very relevant to your business.
The best affiliates generally don't come inbound. The Affiliate Finder enables you to take control over the success of your affiliate program by actively finding affiliates that are a great fit for your business.
How Do My Affiliates Access Their Links and Coupon Codes?
Your affiliates will have access to a dedicated portal where they can easily find and manage their affiliate links and coupon codes .
Does Rewardful Support PayPal Integration?
Yes, you can connect Rewardful with PayPal . Leverage this integration for mass affiliate payments. You can also pay your affiliates in bulk using Wise.
Can I Build a Customizable Affiliate Program With Rewardful?
Yes, Rewardful's Developer API empowers you to create a customized affiliate program. Tailor the affiliate dashboard layout, colors, and data to match your brand and needs, and even control how the affiliate system operates.

Pricing FAQ
Clear answers about Rewardful plans, fees and billing.
Does Rewardful charge transaction fees?
No. Every Rewardful plan has a 0% transaction fee on affiliate-attributed revenue. Rewardful does not take a percentage of that revenue.
What is not included in the 0% transaction fee?
Affiliate commissions, optional Managed Payouts fees, affiliate withdrawal fees, and fees charged by payment or payout providers are separate.
What does Managed Payouts cost?
Managed Payouts is optional and available on every plan. Merchants pay a 3% processing fee on payouts. Affiliates may also pay withdrawal fees based on their payout method and location.
How does annual billing work?
Annual billing provides 12 months for the price of 10. Starter is $490/year, Growth is $990/year, and Enterprise starts at $1,490/year.
Is there a free trial?
Yes. Every plan includes a 14-day free trial.

What is not included in the 0% transaction fee?
Affiliate commissions, optional Managed Payouts fees, affiliate withdrawal fees, and fees charged by payment or payout providers are separate.

Managed Payouts is optional and available on every plan. Merchants pay a 3% processing fee on payouts. Affiliates may also pay withdrawal fees based on their payout method and location.

Annual billing provides 12 months for the price of 10. Starter is $490/year, Growth is $990/year, and Enterprise starts at $1,490/year.

Product Updates
Stay in the loop on our latest product updates.
New feature
Jun 5, 2026
Introducing the Assets Library: Affiliate Materials in One Place Give your affiliates everything they need to promote your business with our new Assets Library feature.
Previously, merchants had to share logos, PDFs, links, and promotional copy through external tools like email, shared drives, or docs. This made assets harder to manage and harder for affiliates to find when they needed them.
Now, you can manage your promotional assets directly inside Rewardful from the new Assets tab. Merchants can upload files, save useful links, and create text snippets for affiliates to use, all in one central library. All published assets are available to all affiliates across all campaigns.
This feature helps you:
Keep affiliate assets organized in one place.
Share files, links, and text copy without relying on external tools.
Save materials as drafts before publishing them to affiliates.
Make it easier for affiliates to find and use the latest promotional resources.
Edit and delete assets from the library, making it easier to manage your affiliate resources as your program grows.
How to use the Assets Library:
Go to the new Assets tab in your Rewardful dashboard.
Click Upload Assets .
Choose whether you want to add a File , Link , or Text asset.
Save the asset as a draft or publish it to your library for affiliates to access.
Once published, affiliates will see the asset in their Assets tab and can access it right away.
Technical information:
Supported file formats: JPG, PNG and PDF
Maximum file size: 25MB
Improvement
Mar 25, 2026
PDF Invoices for Managed Payouts Merchants Managed Payouts merchants can now download invoice PDFs directly from Rewardful, making it easier to keep billing records organized and accessible. This gives merchants a clearer, more convenient way to save invoices for finance and accounting needs without leaving the product.
What this means for you:
Easier invoice record-keeping
Invoice PDFs available directly in Rewardful
A more convenient workflow for finance and accounting
How to use it:
Open the relevant invoice in Rewardful.
Click Download Invoice .
New feature
Dec 5, 2025
Rewardful Simplifies Affiliate Payouts With Managed Payouts Managing affiliate payouts shouldn’t drain your day. We’re excited to introduce Managed Payouts — a new Rewardful feature designed to streamline and consolidate affiliate commissions into one clean, reliable workflow.
Previously, paying affiliates meant chasing tax forms, reconciling invoices, and sending dozens of payments across PayPal, Wise, and bank transfers.
Now, you’ll fund a single invoice to Rewardful and we’ll handle the rest. Commissions are distributed to affiliates, who can withdraw right from their Rewardful dashboard via local bank transfer, SEPA transfer, wire transfer, PayPal, or check.
Managed Payouts helps you:
Consolidate affiliate payouts into one simple process, replacing multiple providers and manual steps.
Reduce admin and errors with tracked, reconciled, on‑time payments.
Stay compliant with simplified tax documentation and clear invoices.
Now generally available.
Improvement
Aug 19, 2025
Block Referral Traffic from Custom Domains Take control of how referral traffic is tracked with our new Block Referral Traffic from Custom Domains feature.
Previously, blocking referral traffic was limited to major search engines like Google and Bing.
Now, you can block specific domains, including AI-driven platforms like ChatGPT and Gemini, as well as any custom domain of your choice. This can be done directly in the Campaign Settings under Traffic Source Control .
This feature helps you:
Prevent affiliates from gaining an unfair advantage through unintended traffic sources.
Ensure program compliance by blocking traffic from domains you don’t want included in referral tracking.
Maintain greater transparency and control over your program’s traffic.
How to block traffic from custom domains:
Go to Campaign Settings > Traffic Source Control .
Toggle ‘Ignore traffic from domains specified by you’.
Add the domains you want to block (single or comma-separated).
Save your changes and you’re done!
This update works independently of the existing ‘Ignore traffic from major search engines’ option, giving you full flexibility to manage your referral traffic sources.
Improvement
Jul 25, 2025
Affiliate Program Management Simplified We have made several quality-of-life improvements to streamline the management of your affiliate program, making it easier and faster for busy merchants handling multiple tasks.
Find Affiliate Invitations Faster with Email Search
Managing affiliate invitations is now much easier.
Previously, finding a specific invitation required scrolling through a lengthy list, which was particularly challenging when managing multiple campaigns or affiliates.
Now, you can search for any email address directly from the Affiliates > Invitations tab.
Search works across all invitation states (Pending, Accepted, Revoked), so it’s faster to resend, revoke, or review any invite — no more digging around.
Centralized Payments Menu
We’ve consolidated all payout- and billing-related settings under a new Payments tab in the main navigation.
Before, payout settings and subscription details were scattered in different parts of the app. Now, everything is in one place:
Payouts
Payout Settings
Your Subscription
This update makes it easier to manage payouts, update payment methods, or review billing info without the need to switch between menus.
Sort Campaigns by Performance
You can now sort campaigns by performance metrics to help you focus on what works best.
In the Campaigns tab , you can sort by:
Number of affiliates
Net revenue
This feature allows you to easily identify your highest-performing campaigns, enabling smarter decisions when managing partnerships or conducting experiments.
